provenance.num_total_tools_note: 113 = len(CORE_TOOLS) + len(ADMIN_TOOLS) = 21 + 92 (unique, DEPRECATED subset of ADMIN). num_total_tools=116 is deliberately larger: it counts the MCP router entry points + aliased/legacy names that are registered on the surface but live outside the tier lists (e.g. memory_maintenance router, memory_advanced alias, plus deprecated-replacement verbs). The two numbers measure different things; do NOT 'fix' num_total_tools to 113 — only reconcile if the registry's own counts drift, not the surface-exposure superset.
